slides.texte_overlay:
5 hobbies to
finally
become
happy again

Taking film photos
Only 36 shots a roll.
You start noticing light,
faces, small moments.
Then you wait for them
like letters.

Growing something
A plant on the window.
Herbs in the kitchen.
Something alive that
needs you every day.

Playing board games
with friends
No screens. Real laughs.
A table full of people
you actually like.

Walking somewhere new
every weekend
A new street, a new park.
Your city gets bigger
the more you look.

Learning about the world
One story from history,
one idea from science.
A curious mind is
rarely bored.
slides.texte_sophia:
Learning about the world
Use a micro-learning app

history, science or art
in 5 minutes a day.
